fact: INSEED's page lists quarterly bulletins of international merchandise trade statistics published for Q1 2024 to Q2 2026 (every quarter of 2025, Q1-Q2 2026), the external trade statistics series that INSEED compiles from customs and extra-customs administrative data (customs source; editions Q1 2024 to Q2 2026).
title: Les Echanges extérieurs - Bulletin trimestriel des statistiques du Commerce international des marchandises
publisher: Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques et démographiques (INSEED)
